headline: USB Pet Rock 2.0
body: It's back. It still does nothing. Now with a USB-C port that also does nothing. Plug it in. Feel nothing. Experience everything.

headline: Miracle Tonic No. 9
body: Cures melancholy, gout, and the suspicion that your houseplants are judging you. They are. Drink up.

headline: We Stand In Line So You Don't Have To
body: Licensed, bonded, emotionally unavailable queue-standers. From DMV to Supreme drops. We'll be there. You won't.

headline: Bottled Air from 1997
body: Pre-millennium. Pre-wifi. Pre-your-mistakes. Each bottle vacuum-sealed on a Tuesday afternoon in March, 1997.

headline: The Gym You Can't See
body: Our equipment is invisible. Our trainers are theoretical. Your membership is very, very real.

headline: Hand-Crafted Silence
body: Artisanal silence, harvested at dawn from the Swiss Alps. Shipped in a matte black box. Open carefully.

headline: Your Pet, But Forever
body: Fluffy deserves immortality. Our artisans preserve the exact expression they had when you left for work.

headline: Undo Your Divorce
body: Our lawyers specialize in retroactive decisions. One phone call, and it's like 2019 never happened.

headline: Insurance for Things That Won't Happen*
body: *Probably. Meteor strikes, spontaneous combustion, your cat learning to file taxes. We've got you covered.*

headline: A Blockchain for Your Feelings
body: Immutably record every emotion. Mint your breakdowns. Stake your joy. Web3 meets therapy, badly.

headline: Premium Subscription Moss
body: Not all moss is created equal. Ours is curated by a man named Gerald who takes this very seriously.

headline: Beige. That's It.
body: We sell beige. Shirts, walls, emotions. All beige. Pantone 468 of the soul.

headline: Try Before You Cry
body: Why commit to your own mistakes? Rent one of ours. Mild to devastating. Weekly plans available.

headline: Yacht Insurance for People Without Yachts
body: You don't have a yacht. But if you did, you'd want this. Peace of mind for the imaginary fleet.

headline: Poses Smaller Than an Atom
body: You can't see the poses. Neither can we. That's how you know it's working.

headline: Homes With History. Bad History.
body: 3 bed, 2 bath, 1 persistent presence. Priced to move. It also moves on its own.

headline: Energy Drink From 2003
body: Found in a warehouse. Probably still carbonated. Definitely still aggressive.

headline: A Chair That Believes In You
body: Ergonomically designed to support your lower back and your questionable life choices.

headline: Store Your Files in an Actual Cloud
body: We hired a weather balloon. Your data is now somewhere over Nebraska. Good luck.

headline: Iron a Shirt. On a Cliff.
body: You've ironed at home. Cute. Try ironing at 4,000 meters with wind shear. Membership open.

headline: Sing Your Heart Out. Internally.
body: All the joy of karaoke without the burden of sound. Machine included. Microphone is decorative.

headline: Hand-Selected Dryer Lint
body: Grade-A lint. Each fiber whispered to. Ships in a velvet pouch. Use responsibly.

headline: Hats for the Discerning Paranoid
body: Foil-lined fashion. Block 5G, bad vibes, and eye contact. Runway-tested in three bunkers.

headline: Find Love With Someone Scripted
body: Our matches have three dialogue options and a heart of if-statements. Stable. Predictable. Loyal.

headline: Sounds That Will Hurt You
body: Forks on plates. Styrofoam. A man describing his commute. Volume up, coward.

headline: Your Fern Deserves a Pension
body: After years of photosynthesizing for you, give back. 401(k) for ferns. IRA for ivy.

headline: One Spark. That's It.
body: A single sparkler lit in an empty field. No colors. No noise. Just the concept of celebration.

headline: Pass Down a JPEG to Your Grandchildren
body: This 800x600 image has been in our family for generations. Now it can be in yours. Forever. On a hard drive.

headline: Sit. Win. Repeat.
body: Regional qualifiers now open. Categories include: Armchair, Folding, Stool (advanced).

headline: A Subscription to Nothing
body: $4.99/month. You receive nothing. Monthly. Cancel anytime, but why would you?

headline: Because the Right Ones Always Leave
body: A subscription box of left socks. Just the left. Accept the asymmetry. Become whole.

headline: Own a Bunker for the End Times
body: Two weeks a year in a luxury doomsday bunker. Rotate with other preppers. BYO canned beans.

headline: The Boring Cousin of White Noise
body: Sounds like a waiting room feels. Fall asleep to the hum of a fluorescent light in 1994.

headline: Visit Places Where Bad Things Happened
body: Guided tours of historically awkward locations. The Alamo? Too mainstream. Try the site of the 1977 Molasses Spill.

headline: A Shirt That Takes 6 Years to Ship
body: We plant the cotton when you order. Harvest by hand. Weave with intention. Deliver to your adult child.

headline: Dust From Famous Places
body: Attic of a forgotten novelist. Shelf of a retired librarian. Each vial authenticated. Sniff responsibly.

headline: Get Married in a Dollhouse
body: Intimate. Very intimate. Your witnesses are a family of well-dressed mice. Cake is a crumb.

headline: We Throw Away Your Stuff
body: Our consultants enter your home and remove 90% of your belongings. You didn't need that lamp. Or that chair. Or those photos.

headline: Heavy Metal Baby Clothes
body: Onesies for infants who shred. Leather diapers. Tiny studded boots. Pacifier optional, attitude mandatory.

headline: Pre-Owned Prophecies
body: These cards have seen things. Other people's things. Now they can see yours. Slightly haunted. Deeply discounted.

headline: Scents That Shouldn't Exist
body: New offerings: Hospital Corridor, Grandpa's Attic, Mild Regret, Unattended Seafood. Burn time: yes.

headline: You're Simultaneously Fit and Not
body: Until you look in the mirror, you are in peak physical condition. Membership preserves the superposition.

headline: Travel the World. Say Sorry.
body: Guided trips to places you've wronged. Exes. Old roommates. That barista from 2018. Closure, with airfare.

headline: A Course on Owning Less, That You Buy
body: 12 modules. 4 workbooks. 1 tote bag. All to teach you that you don't need things. $299.

headline: Custom Storms for Events
body: Weddings. Funerals. Gender reveals. Our meteorologists deliver the exact weather you ordered. Rain on schedule.

headline: Books You Have to Fight For
body: The new Murakami is on a cliff. The receipt you need is in a bear's den. Card catalog is a riddle. Good luck.

headline: Your Grandmother's Breath, Bottled
body: We captured it in 1987. She didn't know. Now it's a family heirloom. Display prominently. Open on holidays.

headline: Vacations You Won't Remember
body: We take you somewhere beautiful. We erase the memory. You keep the tan. Trust us, it was great.

headline: Monthly Deliveries to the Deceased
body: They may be gone, but they can still receive a curated box. Flowers. Candles. A note that says 'still thinking of you.' Auto-renews.

headline: Lights That Judge You
body: The thermostat sighs when you walk in. The fridge reminds you of your goals. Alexa, but disappointed.
